HEXA LANDING · iOS

Support

Hexa Landing is our physics puzzle game. The installed app currently uses its original working name, Steady Drop.

Contact us

Email chandler@epanda.com.cn with your device model, iOS version, app version, and a description of the issue. Please do not include passwords or verification codes.

Sign-in and connection

An account and an internet connection are required. You can sign in with your email and password or with Sign in with Apple. If you cannot sign in or complete password recovery, contact support using the email address above.

Lives and rewarded ads

Lives replenish daily. You can choose to watch a rewarded ad when you need another life. Ads depend on availability. A life is granted only after the advertisement's reward conditions are met and the reward is verified by our server. If no ad is available, no life is added. If a completed reward appears delayed, use the game's sync action or reopen the app and contact support if it remains missing.

Progress and account deletion

Unlocked levels and stars are stored on your device separately for each account. They are not automatically synchronized to another device. Your life balance is managed through your account.

To delete your account, open Settings in the game and choose Delete Account. The game asks you to verify your identity before deletion. You can also contact support for account or privacy requests.

Privacy

Read our Privacy Policy for information about accounts, game records, advertising, and your choices.
